## Extension rules (IMPORTANT)
- The existing project already works. DO NOT modify, rename, move, or delete
  any existing file, function, table, or endpoint.
- Add new features ONLY as new files/modules in new subfolders (e.g. backend/extras/).
- If integration is needed, make the smallest possible addition
  (e.g. one new import or one new route registration) and show me the diff first.
- Database changes must be additive: new tables only, no altering existing ones.
- Every new feature must have its own tests in tests/extras/.
- If something is unclear, ask before changing anything.
